function identity<T>(value:T):T {return value;}
[1, 2].map(identity)[0].toUpperCase();
['a', 'b'].map(identity)[0].toFixed();
function transform<A, B>(value:A,fn:(value:A)=>B):B {return fn(value);}
function constrained<T extends {length:number}>(value:T):T {return value;}
transform(3, constrained);
const wrong: string = transform(3, identity);
const numeric:3=transform(3,identity);
const text:'a'=transform('a',identity);
const object = transform({kind:'a'}, identity);
const kind:'a'=object.kind;
type GenericReturn = ReturnType<typeof identity>;
const unknownValue = undefined as GenericReturn;
unknownValue.toFixed();

function objectCallback<A,B>(callbacks:{fn:(value:A)=>B},value:A):B {return callbacks.fn(value);}
function arrayCallback<A,B>(callbacks:[(value:A)=>B],value:A):B {return callbacks[0](value);}
objectCallback({fn:identity},3).toUpperCase();
arrayCallback([identity],'hello').toFixed();
const narrow:3=objectCallback({fn:identity},3);
